Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. title: Product Owner - Tax Reporting
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Product Owner/ Business Analyst – Tax Reporting  
Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD  
About the Role  
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.  

Agile & Scrum Delivery  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.  

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.  

Education: BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent.  

Flexibility to work in rotational shifts when required.
